checked: alpha equals the degree of the independence polynomial
x is the first negative zero-extended difference, scanning through alpha
both eligibility inequalities at every recorded row
listed favorable tags equal exactly the tags with strictly negative deletion difference
every original leaf tag is selected in every eligible row
selected term tags equal selected leaf tags
each recorded aggregate equals the sum of its selected terms

limitations: The replay uses the route's implementation; no separately implemented polynomial engine was run.
No extension beyond the stated finite profile boundary or proof of the registered primary follows.
